deviations.description: Cord shortfall of roughly 0.3 to 1 Gy (cord_floor exceeds cord_lim) with no other trigger. The cord-detector units (4, 6, 9) have biases near -0.5 and only fire beyond about 1 to 4 Gy, so the network plans these requests. Checked by hand at a 1 Gy shortfall (score about -24, plan); the range is approximate and depends on anatomy.
deviations.condition: (cord_floor - cord_lim > 0.3) and (cord_floor - cord_lim < 0.9) and (cov <= cap) and (not (mand_in_ptv - 0.05*ptv_vol > 0.1 and cov > mand_lim)) and (missing == 0)
